问题现场已关闭或更换，请重新记录现场: The recorded state was closed or replaced. Record it again
请填写 5 至 {max} 字的问题描述: Describe the problem in 5 to {max} characters
恢复选项应为布尔值: The resume option has to be true or false
请先等待游戏启动或窗口调整完成，再记录问题现场: Wait for the game start or window resize to finish before recording the state
报告不存在，请重新生成: The report doesn't exist. Create it again
任务已改变或被手动暂停、停止，请关闭报告后手动操作: The task changed or was paused or stopped by hand. Close the report and continue by hand
脚本已保存，但加载超时。请稍后再试，或重启客户端: The script was saved but took too long to load. Try again shortly or restart the client
模板不存在，可能已被删除: The template doesn't exist. It may have been deleted
脚本不存在，可能已被删除: The script doesn't exist. It may have been deleted
脚本太大，无法保存: The script is too large to save
脚本里没有找到任务类，无法运行: No task class found in the script, so it can't run
文件名只能用英文字母、数字、下划线和连字符: File names can only use English letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens
脚本包为空或太大: The script package is empty or too large
还没有连接游戏窗口，无法截图: The game window isn't connected, so nothing can be captured
枚举文件只能放在 ok_tasks 文件夹里，例如 {path}: The enum file has to be in the ok_tasks folder, for example {path}
还没有标注，无需保存: There are no boxes to save yet
只有调试模式可以保存到 assets: Only debug mode can save to assets
已有同名脚本: A script with this name already exists
没有截到画面，请确认游戏窗口可见: No picture captured. Make sure the game window is visible
还没有连接游戏窗口，无法录制: The game window isn't connected, so nothing can be recorded
这台电脑上无法录制鼠标操作: Mouse actions can't be recorded on this computer
请从 ok-bd2 客户端重新打开界面: Open the interface again from the ok-bd2 client
运行所需的组件缺失或已修复，需要重新启动 ok-bd2: Required components were missing or have been repaired. Restart ok-bd2
打开客户端时自动启动游戏: Start the game when the client opens
通过 Starter 启动，和开始任务时一样。: Starts through the Starter, the same as when a task starts.
关闭窗口时最小化到托盘: Minimize to tray when closing the window
游戏在后台时静音: Mute the game in the background
连上游戏时，画面不是支持的大小就自动调到最接近的 16:9。: On connecting to the game, an unsupported size changes to the nearest 16:9.
游戏退出时关闭客户端: Close the client when the game exits
用显卡加速识别（DirectML）: Use the graphics card for recognition (DirectML)
文字识别用显卡计算。改了之后重新打开客户端生效。: Text recognition runs on the graphics card. Applies after you reopen the client.
自动登录等触发任务每次检查之间等待的毫秒数，调大可以降低占用。: Milliseconds between checks by triggered tasks such as automatic login. A higher value uses less CPU.
游戏启动后关闭 Starter: Close the Starter after the game starts
游戏窗口出现后结束 Starter 进程。: Ends the Starter process once the game window appears.
模糊游戏内 UID 等区域: Blur in-game regions such as the UID
在游戏画面上盖住 UID 等固定区域，减轻 OLED 烧屏。: Covers fixed regions such as the UID on the game picture to reduce OLED burn-in.
两次更新遮盖之间的秒数。: Seconds between updates of the cover.
任务完成、出错或游戏启动失败时，在屏幕右下角弹出通知。: Shows a notification in the corner of the screen when a task finishes or fails, or the game can't start.
发到 Discord 频道的 Webhook。: A webhook for a Discord channel.
通过 Telegram Bot 发给你。: Sent to you by a Telegram bot.
通过 QQ 机器人 API 发到频道。: Sent to a channel through the QQ bot API.
会操作电脑上的 QQ 窗口，可能打断你正在做的事，也可能发送失败。关闭后这一项不: This operates the QQ window on your computer, which can interrupt you and may fail to send. Once turned off, this option no longer appears.
会操作电脑上的微信窗口，可能打断你正在做的事，也可能发送失败。关闭后这一项不再显: This operates the WeChat window on your computer, which can interrupt you and may fail to send. Once turned off, this option no longer appears.
登录 Windows 后自动打开启动器。: Opens the launcher after you sign in to Windows.
启动器如何安装新版本。: How the launcher installs new versions.
通过你的邮箱服务器发送通知邮件。: Sends notification emails through your mail server.
登录邮箱服务器用的账号，一般就是邮箱地址。: The account for the mail server, usually your email address.
在邮箱设置里生成的授权码，通常不是登录密码。: A code generated in your email settings, usually not your login password.
587 端口用 STARTTLS，465 端口用 SSL。: Port 587 uses STARTTLS, and port 465 uses SSL.
按顺序执行已开启的公会、小屋、酒馆、抽抽乐、快速狩猎、广场、跑图、跑商和PVP。: Runs the enabled guild, home, pub, draws, Quick Hunt, square, map collection, trading and PVP tasks in order.
应用启动后，当存在今日未完成且调度到期的日常子任务时，自动以「仅执行今日未完成」: After the app starts, if any daily step is due and not done today, Complete dailies runs in "only what's unfinished today" mode. Finished steps are still skipped.
一键完成日常运行成功且全部已启用子任务今日均已完成（含运行前就已完成的项目）后，: When Complete dailies succeeds and every enabled step is done for today (including those finished earlier), the computer shuts down after a 60-second countdown. Run shutdown /a in a command prompt to cancel.
沿用每周跑图卡片的配置；执行剩余时，今日额度已用尽或本周已完成则跳过。技能次数每: Uses the Weekly map collection settings. When running what's left, it is skipped if today's quota is used up or the week is done. Skill uses reset daily at 08:00, resources on Monday at 08:00 (Beijing time).
执行公会签到、小屋签到、酒馆一键收菜和常客圣石领取。: Runs the guild check-in, home check-in, pub Claim All and the regulars' crystal claim.
一键领取经营奖励，随后进入餐厅领取常客圣石。: Claims all business rewards, then enters the restaurant to claim the regulars' crystals.
按双倍状态选择规则，依次执行自定义刷取步骤。: Chooses a rule by bonus state and runs your farming steps in order.
自动补充数量最少的属性，或指定需要的属性。: Tops up the element with the fewest crystals, or the ones you choose.
圣石洞穴独立使用火把，不占用米饭预算。: Crystal caves use torches separately, not your rice budget.
按周进度依次采集剧情、角色与活动卡带；剧情第6章不参与采集，可自选卡带、屏蔽卡带: Collects story, character and event cartridges by weekly progress. Story chapter 6 is left out, and you can choose or block cartridges or finish just one. Resources reset on Monday at 08:00 and skill uses daily at 08:00 (Beijing time). Each cartridge's route runs Absorb, Gather and Suppress, with remaining uses read from the game.
按周进度依次处理剧情、角色与活动卡带；剧情第6章不参与采集。活动游戏卡页找不到的: Handles story, character and event cartridges by weekly progress. Story chapter 6 is left out. Event cartridges not on the event page count as not owned and are skipped without affecting the week. Remaining skill uses are read from the game.
开启后只采集下方勾选的卡带；关闭时采集全部剧情、角色与活动卡带。: When on, only the cartridges checked below are collected. When off, all story, character and event cartridges are.
本次运行新完成一张卡带后即停止。: Stops after this run finishes one more cartridge.
逗号分隔的卡带名或“类别_编号”短前缀，如“Story_01_血骑士, Stor: Cartridge names or "Category_Number" prefixes, separated by commas, such as "Story_01_血骑士, Story_3, Character_2, Event_4". Blocked cartridges aren't collected.
关闭后只执行吸收与召集；已完成的部分动作可在后续运行继续核验。: When off, only Absorb and Gather run. Finished actions can still be verified in later runs.
每日按配置依次执行购买、制作料理和出售。: Each day, buys, cooks and sells in order as configured.
购买阶段后按优先级制作料理，全部选择 MAX；灰色料理跳过，当天同一配置已确认制: After buying, cooks by priority at MAX. Greyed-out dishes are skipped, and a dish confirmed today under the same settings isn't repeated.
额外制作的白框五道料理，默认不选；街头烤鸡肉串始终最后制作。: The five extra white-framed dishes, off by default. Street chicken skewers are always cooked last.
进行pvp自动战斗；北京时间周日23:00至周一08:00结算期间跳过。: Runs automatic PVP battles, skipping the settlement from Sunday 23:00 to Monday 08:00 Beijing time.
目标鸡尾酒消耗倍率，支持 1～40 的任意整数（含 2 倍）。AP 不足时会临时: The cocktail multiplier to aim for, any whole number from 1 to 40 (2 included). It drops to 1 for now if AP runs short.
左右拖动调整任务列表宽度，双击恢复默认: Drag to resize the task list; double-click to reset
任务每次更新运行状态都会写一行日志，内容与任务页的运行状态相同。: Each time a task updates its run status it writes a log line; these repeat the run status on the task page.
检查连接、识别文字，或临时运行一段代码。: Check the connection, recognize text, or run a code snippet.
基础检查不会启动游戏。OCR 读取已连接窗口的当前画面，并保存识别截图。: Basic checks do not start the game. OCR reads the connected window and saves the recognized screenshot.
请先在设备页连接游戏，再使用 OCR。: Connect the game on the Device page before using OCR.
代码可以读写本机文件并操作游戏，只运行你信任的代码。: Code can read and write local files and control the game. Only run code you trust.
可使用 og、executor 和选中的 task；变量在多次运行之间保留，最后: Use og, executor and the selected task. Variables persist between runs, and the last expression's value is displayed.
停止请求已发送；代码会在下一次等待、截图或任务检查时结束。: Stop requested. Code stops at its next wait, capture, or task check.
工具操作进行中，其他任务和配置修改暂时不可用。: A tool is running. Other tasks and configuration changes are unavailable until it finishes.
输出较长，页面只保留前 100000 个字符。: Long output: only the first 100000 characters are shown.
运行后的输出会显示在这里。: Output will appear here after a run.
在游戏窗口上显示识别区域。: Show recognized regions over the game window.
让受信任的本机编程工具连接客户端。默认关闭，需要连接时再开启。: Allow trusted local coding tools to connect. Off by default; enable it when needed.
连接令牌保存在以下本机文件中，请只交给你信任的工具，不要发送到群聊或问题报告。: The connection token is stored in the local file below. Share it only with trusted tools, never in group chats or problem reports.
连接的工具可以使用你的账户权限运行 Python、读取或修改文件，并操作客户端和: Connected tools can run Python with your account permissions, read or modify files, and control the client and game. Connect only trusted tools and keep the connection token private.
调试操作正在进行，请等待或停止后再试: A development operation is running. Wait for it to finish or stop it first
请先等待游戏启动结束，再使用工具: Wait for game startup to finish before using tools
请先连接游戏窗口和截图方式，再识别文字: Connect the game window and capture method before recognizing text
MCP 开关应为布尔值: The MCP setting must be a boolean
请先确认允许受信任的本机程序控制客户端: Confirm that trusted local programs may control the client first
代码太长，请改为脚本后运行: The code is too long. Save and run it as a script
